mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month but 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month signal a weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline over the prior month but 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative due to reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines in a supply shock regime but 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% annually signals inflationary pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 3.0% annually but 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in total non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises over the prior month but 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior quarter signal a deteriorating economic expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline over the prior quarter but 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply expansion regime characterized by a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are positive due to stronger manufacturing output and corporate profits.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises in a supply expansion regime but 20-day forward returns are negative.
